name: Share the transparent default color

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown:
## Share the transparent default color

Mechanism: `Color::transparent_black()` (every `Color::default()`, so every `Background::default()` and every style's default colors) allocated an Arc and wrote a ColorInner each call; hand out a per-thread shared one. Allowed: gpux_color value.rs. Forbidden: any other Color construction.
measurementPlanMarkdown: A/B (HEAD, then the change, same session, 3 reps) over effects-cards, hover-grid, scroll-div-cards (an earlier combined run read effects-cards +44% for it). Pass: allocations down, CPU not worse beyond noise.

measurements.delta: -32% (that scenario alternates between 1.8 and 2.7 ms across runs, in both builds)

reportMarkdown:
## Share the transparent default color Finished

Passed: true. The +44% on effects-cards in experiment 11's combined run was that scenario's bimodal behaviour (about 1.8 ms or about 2.7 ms in the same build depending on the run), not this change. Allocations fall 12-18%, CPU 2-3%. New test `transparent_black_is_one_color_per_thread`; color tests pass, clippy/fmt clean.

Attempt Count: 1.
decisionMarkdown:
### Decision
